description:
This is a proposal to install a heatpump to Flat 1. The heatpump proposed placement is in the front garden, behind a bush and will be best placed here to connect to the existing pipes etc, as the old boiler is removed. 36 Avenue Road consists of 3 flats and Flat 1 is approximately half the area of the property.

Given many of the questions in the application are not relevant to this type of project, or ask for specifics beyond my knowledge but require an answer, I have answered as best as possible to avoid needing to find new information or complete further questions. If any of the answers are required, please let me know and I can follow up separately.
site_name: Flat 1, 36 Avenue Road, Hornsey, London, N6 5DW
